parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The client ID if you set IdentityType to CLIENT.

parameters.name: IdentityType
parameters.description:
The identity type. Valid values:

*   USER
*   CLIENT

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance.

parameters.name: SignMode
parameters.description: The signature verification mode. ORIGIN: compares the password and the AccessKey secret. SIGNED: uses the HMAC_SHA1 algorithm to sign the client ID to obtain a password and then compares the password.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. The value cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt update-custom-auth-identity --instance-id post-1110000 --username test --secret xxxx --identity-type USER --client-id GID_test@@@test --sign-mode SIGNED --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt UpdateCustomAuthIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --Secret xxxx --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'post-1110000' --Username test --SignMode SIGNED --ClientId 'GID_test@@@test'
